scripts.test:gate4:hashes: node --input-type=module -e "import {createHash} from 'node:crypto'; import {readFile} from 'node:fs/promises'; const files={ 'gym/taste/decisions/td-20260822-izanami1.json':'b82a3b05c422d21f994efbfd4a1c467ca32c516b9a9e711942db81bee799a238', 'gym/taste/profile.json':'0271cc79bbf3a8d247100501c02bacc4ad2615836154ed97ad8befcefd2a1471', 'gym/knowledge/sources/registry.json':'2e05e111be67230c1f26524368ad7bcb298a4bd483f39f4d6dbf8c56d443072c', 'gym/runs/case-fe653973ef/case.json':'6c0761857981d0ac7e99963049ae0fdb0d592d000130666d238b7d0e2e8cabe4', 'gym/runs/case-fe653973ef/review-package.html':'fa01c0ab7dca3929256a359cefe787f04b693e6146aaebd863de1fc819c7d0c4', 'gym/knowledge/negative/nk-izanami-human-quality-floor-batch1.json':'e589ee0f8d080f184fbd141168cb5b5b532ae295181709758bd31864044f4074' }; for (const [path, expected] of Object.entries(files)) { const actual=createHash('sha256').update(await readFile(path)).digest('hex'); if (actual!==expected) { console.error('HASH_MISMATCH', path, actual); process.exit(1); } } const registry=JSON.parse(await readFile('gym/knowledge/sources/registry.json','utf8')); if (registry.registry_version!=='0.1.2' || registry.sources.length!==27) { console.error('REGISTRY_INVARIANT', registry.registry_version, registry.sources.length); process.exit(1);} console.log('T36 protected hashes + registry 0.1.2/27: PASS');"
scripts.test:gate4:coverage: node --input-type=module -e "import {readFile} from 'node:fs/promises'; const files=['engine/tests/test-phase2-5-contracts.mjs','engine/tests/test-phase2-5-resume.mjs','engine/tests/test-phase2-5-capture.mjs','engine/tests/test-review-package-links.mjs','engine/tests/test-taste-reject-all.mjs']; const text=(await Promise.all(files.map((p)=>readFile(p,'utf8')))).join('\n'); const ts=new Set([...text.matchAll(/\\bT(\\d+)\\b/g)].map((m)=>Number(m[1]))); const cvs=new Set([...text.matchAll(/\\bCV(\\d+)\\b/g)].map((m)=>Number(m[1]))); const missingT=[...Array(48)].map((_,i)=>i+1).filter((n)=>!ts.has(n)); const missingCV=[...Array(18)].map((_,i)=>i+1).filter((n)=>!cvs.has(n)); if (missingT.length||missingCV.length) { console.error({missingT,missingCV,foundT:[...ts].sort((a,b)=>a-b),foundCV:[...cvs].sort((a,b)=>a-b)}); process.exit(1);} console.log('T36 coverage: PASS (T1-T48, CV01-CV18)');"
scripts.test:gate4:absence: node --input-type=module -e "import {readdir,readFile} from 'node:fs/promises'; import {extname,join} from 'node:path'; async function walk(dir, out=[]) { let entries=[]; try { entries=await readdir(dir,{withFileTypes:true}); } catch { return out; } for (const e of entries) { const p=join(dir,e.name); if (e.isDirectory()) await walk(p,out); else out.push(p); } return out; } const gymFiles=await walk('gym'); const fixtureFiles=await walk('engine/tests/fixtures'); const hits=[...gymFiles,...fixtureFiles].filter((path)=>/wanaka/i.test(path)); for (const path of gymFiles.filter((path)=>extname(path)==='.json')) { if (/wanaka/i.test(await readFile(path,'utf8'))) hits.push(path); } if (hits.length) { console.error('WANAKA_PRESENT', [...new Set(hits)]); process.exit(1);} const design=await readFile('docs/plans/phase-2-5-award-quality-floor/03-program-design.md','utf8'); const switches=['Cron:                              OFF','Auto-promotion:                    OFF','Deployment:                        OFF','Global skill promotion:            OFF','1000-case curriculum:               OFF','10x10 Design Gym:                  OFF']; const missing=switches.filter((line)=>!design.includes(line)); if (missing.length) { console.error('SIDE_EFFECT_SWITCH_NOT_OFF', missing); process.exit(1);} const pkg=JSON.parse(await readFile('package.json','utf8')); const enabled=Object.entries(pkg.scripts).filter(([name,command])=>name!=='test:gate4:absence' && /cron|deploy|auto.?promot|phase.?3|1000.?case|10x10/i.test(name+' '+command)); if (enabled.length) { console.error('FORBIDDEN_SCRIPT_ENABLED', enabled); process.exit(1);} console.log('T36 Wanaka absence + side-effect switches: PASS');"

scripts.test:calibration:safety: node --input-type=module -e "import {readdir,readFile} from 'node:fs/promises'; const id='case-ee9eaf0dc9'; const run=JSON.parse(await readFile('gym/runs/'+id+'/case.json','utf8')); const slots=Object.keys(run.slots??{}); const v0=run.slots?.V0; const variantFiles=await readdir('gym/runs/'+id+'/variants').catch(()=>[]); if (run.schema!=='kinetic/gym/case-run@0.2'||run.case_id!==id||slots.length!==3||slots.sort().join(',')!=='V0,V1,V2'||v0?.mode!=='fidelity-study'||v0?.deployable!==false||v0?.original_work!==false||v0?.design_qualified!==null||v0?.acceptable_for_further_taste_learning!==null||!['V1','V2'].every(slot=>{const s=run.slots?.[slot]; return s?.mode==='original'&&s?.deployable===true&&s?.original_work===true&&s?.state==='HUMAN_REVIEWED'&&s?.design_qualified===(slot==='V2')&&s?.acceptable_for_further_taste_learning===(slot==='V2');})||run.review_state!=='HUMAN_REVIEWED'||run.taste_decision_ref!=='taste/decisions/td-20260901-wanaka-v1-v2.json'||variantFiles.some((name)=>/^v3$/i.test(name))) { console.error('CALIBRATION_SAFETY_VIOLATION',{slots,v0,variantFiles}); process.exit(1); } console.log('Real calibration safety: PASS (V0 protected; V1 rejected; V2 floor/learning accepted)');"
